title.zh: Visa 据报洽谈以约 25 亿美元收购 Fireblocks，Fireblocks 否认
title.en: Visa reportedly in talks to acquire Fireblocks for about $2.5 billion

current_state.zh: Fireblocks 否认了有关 Visa 正就以约 25 亿美元收购其进行后期谈判的报道，Visa 则拒绝置评。
current_state.en: Fireblocks denied a report that Visa is in late-stage talks to acquire it for about $2.5 billion, while Visa declined to comment.
